58093-round-the-sofa-vol-2.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Dawson had been recommended to the French book which he named, as containing the fullest and most authentic account of this mysterious race, the Cagots. I did not think I should like hearing this paper as much as a story; but, of course, as he meant it kindly, we were bound to submit, and I found it, on the whole, more interesting than I anticipated.

arxiv-2108-13442.title: Measuring the H i content of individual galaxies out to the epoch of reionization with [C ii ] Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2108-13442.creator: Kasper E. Heintz, Darach Watson, Pascal A. Oesch, Desika Narayanan, Suzanne C. Madden
arxiv-2108-13442.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kasper E. Heintz, Darach Watson, Pascal A. Oesch, Desika Narayanan, Suzanne C. Madden. The H i gas content is a key ingredient in galaxy evolution, the study of which has been limited to moderate cosmological distances for individual galaxies due to the weakness of the hyperfine H i 21-cm transition.

arxiv-2109-13836.title: Laws of Nature as Constraints
arxiv-2109-13836.creator: Emily Adlam
arxiv-2109-13836.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The laws of nature have come a long way since the time of Newton: quantum mechanics and relativity have given us good reasons to take seriously the possibility of laws which may be non-local, atemporal, ‘all-at-once,’ retrocausal, or in some other way not well-suited to the standard dynamical time evolution paradigm.

arxiv-2111-02208.title: Role extraction for digraphs via neighbourhood pattern similarity
arxiv-2111-02208.creator: Giovanni Barbarino, Vanni Noferini, Paul Van Dooren
arxiv-2111-02208.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Giovanni Barbarino, Vanni Noferini, Paul Van Dooren. We analyse the recovery of different roles in a network modelled by a directed graph, based on the so-called Neighbourhood Pattern Similarity approach. Our analysis uses results from random matrix theory to show that, when assuming that the graph is generated as a particular Stochastic Block Model with Bernoulli probability distributions for the different blocks, then the recovery is asymptotically correct when the graph has a sufficiently large dimension.

arxiv-2112-00807.title: Intervention treatment distributions that depend on the observed treatment process and model double robustness in causal survival analysis
arxiv-2112-00807.creator: Lan Wen a {}^{\text{a}} , Julia L. Marcus b {}^{\text{b}} and Jessica G. Young b {}^{\text{b}} a {}^{\text{a}} Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science, University of Waterloo 200 University Ave W, Waterloo, ON N2L 3G1 b {}^{\text{b}} Department of Population Medicine, Harvard Medical School,
arxiv-2112-00807.description: Abstract . The generalized g-formula can be used to estimate the probability of survival under a sustained treatment strategy. When treatment strategies are deterministic, estimators derived from the so-called efficient influence function (EIF) for the g-formula will be doubly robust to model misspecification.

arxiv-2206-08528.title: SafeRL-Kit: Evaluating Efficient Reinforcement Learning Methods for Safe Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2206-08528.creator: Linrui Zhang, Qin Zhang, Li Shen, Bo Yuan, Xueqian Wang
arxiv-2206-08528.description: Abstract Safe reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success on risk-sensitive tasks and shown promise in autonomous driving (AD) as well. Considering the distinctiveness of this community, efficient and reproducible baselines are still lacking for safe AD. In this paper, we release SafeRL-Kit to benchmark safe RL methods for AD-oriented tasks.

arxiv-2412-05386.title: DIFEM: Key-points Interaction based Feature Extraction Module for Violence Recognition in Videos Journal: Computers and Electrical Engineering
arxiv-2412-05386.creator: Himanshu Mittal, Suvramalya Basak, Anjali Gautam
arxiv-2412-05386.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Himanshu Mittal, Suvramalya Basak, Anjali Gautam. Violence detection in surveillance videos is a critical task for ensuring public safety. As a result, there is increasing need for efficient and lightweight systems for automatic detection of violent behaviours. In this work, we propose an effective method which leverages human skeleton key-points to capture inherent properties of violence, such as rapid movement of specific joints and their close proximity.

arxiv-2501-02575.title: Intrinsic thermal Hall effect of optical phonons enhanced by discrete rotational symmetry
arxiv-2501-02575.creator: Xuesong Hu, Junren Shi
arxiv-2501-02575.description: Abstract We investigate the intrinsic thermal Hall conductivity contributed by optical phonons in a cubic system. The discrete rotational symmetry of the system splits the degeneracy of transverse modes across most regions of wave-vector space, except along a few high-symmetry lines. Consequently, in the presence of an external magnetic field, phonon Berry curvatures become sharply peaked near these high-symmetry lines.

arxiv-2502-02820.title: Slowing Learning by Erasing Simple Features
arxiv-2502-02820.creator: Lucia Quirke, Nora Belrose
arxiv-2502-02820.description: Abstract Prior work suggests that neural networks tend to learn low-order moments of the data distribution first, before moving on to higher-order correlations. In this work, we derive a novel closed-form concept erasure method, QLEACE, which surgically removes all quadratically available information about a concept from a representation.

arxiv-2502-19631.title: Confined tumbling state as the origin of the excess of slowly rotating asteroids
arxiv-2502-19631.creator: Wen-Han Zhou, Patrick Michel, Marco Delbo, Wenchao Wang, Bonny Y. Wang, Josef Ďurech, Josef Hanuš
arxiv-2502-19631.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wen-Han Zhou, Patrick Michel, Marco Delbo, Wenchao Wang, Bonny Y. Wang, Josef Ďurech, Josef Hanuš. The rotational distribution of asteroids as a function of their size is used as a diagnostic of their physical properties and evolution. Recent photometric surveys from the Gaia mission, allowing observation of asteroids with long spin periods (for example ≥ 24 \geq 24 h), found an excessive group of slow rotators and a gap separating them from faster rotators, which is unexplained by current theories.

arxiv-2506-17839.title: Rethinking Ecological Measures Of Functional Diversity
arxiv-2506-17839.creator: Ines Meraoumia, Adji Bousso Dieng
arxiv-2506-17839.description: Abstract Understanding functional diversity, the range and variability of species’ roles and actions within their communities, is key to predicting and preserving the functions that sustain both nature and human well-being. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive review of the literature on functional diversity measurement. We begin by consolidating essential criteria that effective measures of functional diversity should meet.

arxiv-2510-23330.title: The First Star-by-star N N -body/Hydrodynamics Simulation of Our Galaxy Coupling with a Surrogate Model Conference: The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis; November 16–21, 2025; St Louis, MO, USA The International Conference for High Performance
arxiv-2510-23330.creator: Keiya Hirashima, Michiko S. Fujii, Takayuki R. Saitoh, Naoto Harada, Kentaro Nomura, Kohji Yoshikawa, Yutaka Hirai, Tetsuro Asano, Kana Moriwaki, Masaki Iwasawa, Takashi Okamoto, Junichiro Makino
arxiv-2510-23330.description: Abstract . A major goal of computational astrophysics is to simulate the Milky Way Galaxy with sufficient resolution down to individual stars. However, the scaling fails due to some small-scale, short-timescale phenomena, such as supernova explosions. We have developed a novel integration scheme of N N -body/hydrodynamics simulations working with machine learning.

arxiv-2602-16967.title: Early-Warning Signals of Grokking via Loss-Landscape Geometry
arxiv-2602-16967.creator: Yongzhong Xu
arxiv-2602-16967.description: Abstract Grokking refers to the phenomenon in which neural networks abruptly transition from memorization to generalization after extended training. Recent work on modular arithmetic has linked grokking to prolonged confinement on low-dimensional execution manifolds in weight space, followed by a sudden escape into a generalizing solution. A central open question is whether this geometric mechanism extends beyond arithmetic tasks.

britannica-1911-arnault-antoine-vincent.title: Arnault, Antoine Vincent (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-arnault-antoine-vincent.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-arnault-antoine-vincent.description: Article 'Arnault, Antoine Vincent' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. His eldest son, Émilien Lucien (1787–1863), wrote several tragedies, the leading rôles in which were interpreted by Talma. Arnault’s Œuvres complètes (4 vols.) were published at the Hague and Paris in 1818–1819 and again (8 vols.) at Paris in 1824.

britannica-1911-bek-antony.title: Bek, Antony (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-bek-antony.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-bek-antony.description: Article 'Bek, Antony' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 3), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Bek’s elder brother, Thomas Bek (d. 1293), bishop of St David’s, was a trusted servant of Edward I. He obtained many important and wealthy ecclesiastical positions, was made treasurer of England in 1279, and became bishop of St David’s in 1280. He was a benefactor to his diocese and died on the 12th of May 1293.

europmc-pmc4536333.creator: Keane M, Semeiks J, Webb AE, Li YI, Quesada V, Craig T, Madsen LB, van Dam S, Brawand D, Marques PI, Michalak P, Kang L, Bhak J, Yim HS, Grishin NV, Nielsen NH, Heide-Jørgensen MP, Oziolor EM, Matson CW, Church GM, Stuart GW, Patton JC, George JC, Suydam R, Larsen K, López-Otín C, O'Connell MJ, Bickham JW, Thomsen B, de Magalhães JP.

These animals should possess protective molecular adaptations relevant to age-related diseases, particularly cancer. Here, we report the sequencing and...

pmc-11402350.title: Association Between Sleep Characteristics and Likelihood of Prodromal Parkinson’s Disease: A Cross-Sectional Analysis in the HABIT Study
pmc-11402350.creator: Cheng-Jie Mao, Hao Peng, Sheng Zhuang, Ying-Chun Zhang, Wei-Ye Xie, Jia-Hui Yan, Hui-Hui Liu, Jing Chen, Jun-Yi Liu, Jianan Zhang, Hai Jiang, Yonghong Zhang, Mingzhi Zhang, Chun-Feng Liu
pmc-11402350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSleep is critical in health problems including Parkinson’s disease (PD). This study examined the association between sleep characteristics and the likelihood of prodromal PD.MethodsAt baseline examination of the Heart and Brain Investigation in Taicang (HABIT) study, potential PD biomarkers were obtained for 8777 participants aged over 50 years, and the probability of prodromal PD was assessed based on the Chinese expert consensus and Movement Disorder Society (MDS) criteria. General and component sleep characteristics were evaluated by the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI).

pmc-11635862.title: Ectopic corticotropin-releasing hormone syndrome caused by rectal large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma: a rare case report
pmc-11635862.creator: Yuan Lou, Huan Chen, Si-Jia Fei, Qing-Hua He, Qi Pan
pmc-11635862.description: Ectopic corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH) syndrome, a rare subtype of adrenocorticotropic hormone-dependent Cushing syndrome, is associated with tumors of diverse origins. Here, we present a case of a 37-year-old female diagnosed with ectopic CRH syndrome secondary to rectal large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, a hitherto unprecedented site for CRH-secreting tumors.

pmc-12597833.title: First Documented Case of Pneumonia with Nocardia africana and SARS-CoV-2 Co-Detection in Mainland China
pmc-12597833.creator: Xinyi Yu, Jun Cheng, Jing He, Xiaoxia Wu, Weizhong Wang, Mengyuan Chen, Bingqian Zhuo, Yumei Ge
pmc-12597833.description: Nocardia spp. are zoonotic pathogens that can cause infections ranging from localized lesions to systemic dissemination, primarily via pulmonary inhalation or percutaneous inoculation. We report the first confirmed case of Nocardia africana pneumonia with SARS-CoV-2 co-detection in mainland China, diagnosed through bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) analysis using metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) and matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS).

pmc-12636910.title: Prediction of adverse events after acute myocardial infarction: derivation and external validation of an extended CHA2DS2-VASc score model
pmc-12636910.creator: Lina Carlsson, Jerzy Leppert, Jonas Selmeryd, Christina Christersson, Pär Hedberg
pmc-12636910.description: BackgroundThe CHA2DS2-VASc score predicts poor prognosis in patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI), with or without atrial fibrillation. In this observational study, we aimed to evaluate the CHA2DS2-VASc score by itself and extended with clinical data to predict adverse events in patients after AMI.

pmc-12795767.title: Beyond a digital habit: Socio-ecological perspectives on social media disorder among Indonesian college students
pmc-12795767.creator: Ulfi Hida Zainita, Evi Martha, Tiara Amelia, Dewi Safitri
pmc-12795767.description: BackgroundIn Indonesia, with a total population of 278.7 million, it was recorded that almost half the population were social media users (49.9%) in 2024. Studies from various sources report that passive and excessive use of social media, especially in the student age category, is a trigger for Social Media Disorder (SMD).

pmc-13097800.title: The renaissance of research on psychedelics in child and adolescent psychopharmacology
pmc-13097800.creator: Marc-Antoine Crocq, Philippe Auby
pmc-13097800.description: AimsThe recent regulatory approval of esketamine in adults heralded the renaissance of research into psychedelic compounds. However, the relevance of this resurgence for children and adolescents remains unclear. pmc-13642112.title: One‐Step Fabrication of Non‐Ablative Microstructures for Efficient Second Harmonic Generation on LiNbO3 Thin Film
pmc-13642112.creator: Feifei Wang, Yuntao Lang, Changji Pan, Yang Lu, Xiaozhe Chen, Rongke Gao, Zhe Peng, Liandong Yu
pmc-13642112.description: Lithium niobate (LiNbO3) is a key material for nonlinear optics applications, such as second harmonic generation (SHG), due to its strong nonlinear coefficient and broad transparency window. However, its high damage threshold makes it difficult to fabricate high‐quality microstructures, often resulting in low quality factors and poor SHG efficiency.
